items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Hans can do it and give him a copy.

ctx.x: Yeah, oh yeah, and then you have a safety. He has to put a strong light on it. Well, any time you get ready. Have a friend of mine have a good camera. Any time you get ready.
Yeah, Hans can do it and give him a copy. You can do it any time you get ready?
Yeah, because I'd like to keep it for the old cast. That's the only early picture we have of you. You're not in any band pictures.
